description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meddegama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511014
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for two land parcels (Nos. 239 and 251) in the Gampaha District. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classification. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative elements that would trigger Types 1-3.
